title: Prime Minister congratulates Men’s Badminton Team on winning Bronze Medal at Asian Games
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated the Men’s Badminton Team on winning the Bronze Medal at the Asian Games.
The Prime Minister stated that this medal reflects their passion and hard work, noting that the entire team displayed great spirit throughout the competition. Shri Modi further extended his best wishes to them for the events ahead.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"Congratulations to our Men’s Badminton Team on winning the Bronze Medal at the Asian Games!
This medal reflects their passion and hard work. The entire team displayed great spirit throughout the competition.
Best wishes to them for the events ahead: PM @narendramodi"
